scope.summary: Builds and deploys Power Apps code apps for mobile using an Expo / React Native template, including Dataverse data-model planning and provisioning, connector wiring, native device capabilities, Mobile Offline Profiles, screen generation, and deployment through Power Apps Wrap.

externalNetworkCalls: Dataverse Web API (table, column, relationship, and offline-profile writes)
Power Platform BAP API for environment resolution
npm registry and Expo tooling during template preparation

servers.name: microsoft-learn
servers.purpose: Hosted Microsoft Learn documentation lookups for Power Platform behaviour.

dependencies.name: Node.js and npm with Expo toolchain
dependencies.description: The workflow expects a freshly materialized Expo template with npm dependencies installed, including @microsoft/power-apps-native-host.

dependencies.name: Azure CLI (az) sign-in
dependencies.description: Environment resolution and Dataverse calls acquire tokens through the Azure CLI.

dependencies.name: Dataverse environment with maker rights
dependencies.description: Data-model provisioning writes tables, columns, relationships, and mobile offline profiles into the target environment.

dependencies.name: Power Apps Wrap
dependencies.description: Distribution of the generated mobile app depends on Power Apps Wrap being available and approved for the tenant.

dependencies.name: Connector availability under DLP
dependencies.description: Connector-backed skills (SharePoint, Teams, Office 365, Excel, OneDrive, Azure DevOps) depend on the environment's DLP policy allowing the connector.

technologies.name: React Native
technologies.usedFor: Runtime framework for the generated mobile app.

technologies.name: Expo
technologies.usedFor: Build and tooling layer for the generated mobile app.

technologies.name: Tamagui
technologies.usedFor: Design-system and styling layer used by the generated screens.

technologies.name: Model Context Protocol
technologies.usedFor: Optional hosted Microsoft Learn documentation server.

exceptions: The plugin generates React Native (Tamagui) screens and ships its own brand/design-system workflow. EDS does not publish React Native components, so an Equinor mobile design-token mapping is required before this plugin can produce EDS-aligned UI.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills, agents, hooks, and the 20+ bundled Node scripts are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
The plugin writes Dataverse schema and mobile offline profiles directly, so production-system interaction is possible by default.
Technology Radar status is unknown for React Native, Expo, and Tamagui.
No Equinor Design System mapping exists for the generated React Native UI.

The upstream template is materialized with `degit` from `microsoft/power-platform-skills/plugins/mobile-apps/template#main` rather than from this fork; the provenance of the template used at runtime needs an owner decision.
Power Apps Wrap distribution has not been assessed against Equinor mobile application management requirements.

evidence.summary: Initial review after the plugin arrived in the fork through upstream sync 2026-09-09 (mobile-app v0.3.0). The upstream 1DS telemetry stack was excluded, so `scripts/lib/telemetry/`, `scripts/lib/mobile-telemetry*.js`, `hooks/run-telemetry.js`, `scripts/emit-telemetry-checkpoint.js`, `hooks/hooks.json`, and the `/telemetry` skill are not present in this fork.
Documents the Expo template flow, skill catalogue, agents, and deployment through Power Apps Wrap.
Registers only the hosted Microsoft Learn HTTP MCP server; no locally launched MCP process.
162 passing, 1 skipped after removing telemetry-dependent tests and the dead `mobileapp-hook-utils` helper.

CodeQL raised two findings in unmodified upstream code shipped by this plugin: incomplete multi-character HTML sanitization in `scripts/lib/sanitize-external-content.js` and incomplete Markdown cell escaping in `scripts/render-dataverse-planning-evidence.js`. Both are recorded as blockers here rather than patched in the fork, so the fix lands upstream and future syncs do not conflict.

notes: Initial review record only. Publication is deferred until detailed review evidence exists. The telemetry checkpoint calls that remain in the skill workflow prose are inert in this fork because `scripts/emit-telemetry-checkpoint.js` is not shipped; app.json `expo.extra.telemetry.cluster` is likewise never populated because the region resolver is part of the excluded stack.
